title: Unstable Spacetime Aggregate
text: Craft at an Advanced Assembly Table.

128 durability. Hands and inventory drain 1 per 0.5 seconds until detonation; the cursor pauses without restoring durability. Storage restores 1 per 0.5 seconds even while inspected. Returning to inventory resumes decay. A thrown aggregate detonates on impact or exhaustion.

Dropping detonates it immediately. The spherical storm ignores walls and deals 40 direct health damage to all living beings within 10 blocks, including you and allies. It deletes nonliving entities and stationary Omnira workstations without drops. Aeronautics and Create moving structures only lose blocks inside the sphere; stabilization cannot protect them.

A Totem of Undying can save you from a lethal storm. If the storm kills you, Spacetime Amber forms where you died and holds your inventory, equipment and any curios that would have dropped. Right-click your amber to return items to their original slots where possible. Items that do not fit stay inside.
Your Recall Crystal can take you back to the amber as often as needed until it disappears. With Keep Inventory enabled, you keep your items and an empty amber still marks the destination.
You can have one amber at a time. Breaking it or forming a new one spills the old amber’s contents. A spacetime storm destroys both the amber and everything inside.
